The items quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials and other taxes as per the rates prevailing Govt Orders at the time of execution and including all the cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading with all lead and lifts, labour, hire charges of machinary and equipments, etc., complete and all incidental charges. Department will not supply any materials.
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
Epayment Challan should be Scanned
The Tenderer uploaded documents duly attested by Gazzeted Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer.

The item rates are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.(As per prevailing rates GST will be Paid Separately)

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Dept Division Chikkodi during office hours on all working days. If no bid received auto extension will be done by KPPP Portal itself for 2 days
Contractor should prepare Quality Assurance Plan and get approved from Quality Assurance Executive Engineer before starting the work.
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) form practicing Chartered Account is preferred
This bid documents clause no 34.4 to be implemented as per deligation of power vide GO NO PWD 423 FC-1 2018 Bangalore dated 24.09.2018

Fixing  will  be by  drilling  holes  on  the  road  for  the  shanks  to  go  inside, without  nails  and  using  epoxy  resin  based  adhesive  as  per manufacturers recommendation and complete as directed by the engineer.The contractor shall submit a two year warranty for    satisfactory    field    performance    including    stipulated retro-reflectance   of   the   reflecting   panel,   to   the   Engineer.
